bugs.creator: jaganmn2
bugs.summary: S4 bit is not always unset when removing class attribute

comments.text:
The R Internals manual says:

> It is currently unclear what should happen if the class attribute is removed from an S4 object, or if this should be allowed.

Be that as it may, perhaps the behaviour should be consistent across the various ways of removing the class attribute.  Currently, it is not.  For an `OBJSXP`, we see:

```
> bb <- function(s) c(object = is.object(s), S4 = isS4(s))
> setClass("obj", slots = c(. = "logical"))
> x <- new("obj")
> bb(x)
object     S4 
  TRUE   TRUE 
> bb(unclass(x))
object     S4 
 FALSE   TRUE 
> bb(`class<-`(x, NULL))
object     S4 
 FALSE  FALSE 
Warning message:
In bb(`class<-`(x, NULL)) :
  Setting class(x) to NULL;   result will no longer be an S4 object
> bb(`oldClass<-`(x, NULL))
object     S4 
 FALSE  FALSE 
> bb(`attr<-`(x, "class", NULL))
object     S4 
 FALSE   TRUE 
> bb(`attributes<-`(x, NULL))
object     S4 
 FALSE  FALSE 
> bb(`attributes<-`(x, list(notclass = 0)))
object     S4 
 FALSE   TRUE
```

For non-`OBJSXP`, we see the same:

```
> bb <- function(s) c(object = is.object(s), S4 = isS4(s))
> setClass("lgl", contains = "logical")
> y <- new("lgl")
> bb(y)
object     S4 
  TRUE   TRUE 
> bb(unclass(y))
object     S4 
 FALSE   TRUE 
> bb(`class<-`(y, NULL))
object     S4 
 FALSE  FALSE 
Warning message:
In bb(`class<-`(y, NULL)) :
  Setting class(x) to NULL;   result will no longer be an S4 object
> bb(`oldClass<-`(y, NULL))
object     S4 
 FALSE  FALSE 
> bb(`attr<-`(y, "class", NULL))
object     S4 
 FALSE   TRUE 
> bb(`attributes<-`(y, NULL))
object     S4 
 FALSE  FALSE 
> bb(`attributes<-`(y, list(notclass = 0)))
object     S4 
 FALSE   TRUE 
```

It seems that some logic could be added to `do_unclass`, `classgets`, and `do_attributesgets` and elsewhere if it is intended that a warning should always be signalled (though since `attributes<-` is used by `methods::getDataPart` to legitimately make an object "not S4", maybe that should not warn ...).
comments.creator: jaganmn2
